floater.title: Whitelist Folders and Binaries
floater.text:
Anti-virus and Anti-malware are an essential part of safe Internet use, but they can cause a variety of issues for the viewer. To reduce interference and improve stability and performance, we strongly advise that all users ensure that there are exclusions (known as Whitelisting) for important folders and programs that the viewer uses.
Keep antivirus protection enabled. Add a narrowly scoped exception only after confirming a genuine false positive and verifying your installer's origin and integrity. Consult your security software provider's documentation.
To help simplify the task the box below shows the folders the viewer is using. Only add verified components when your security provider confirms an exception is necessary.
The following box shows the names and full paths of the viewer executables. Use these paths only to identify the affected component while investigating a confirmed false positive.
